population.note: Citizens and permanent residents at end-June 2026; non-residents are excluded. Uses published overall totals, not sums of rounded age or subzone cells. Figures are rounded to the nearest 10; a dash denotes nil or negligible.

populationDensity.note: Citizens and permanent residents at end-June 2026; non-residents are excluded. Uses published overall totals, not sums of rounded age or subzone cells. Figures are rounded to the nearest 10; a dash denotes nil or negligible. URA’s SHAPE.AREA in square metres, converted to square kilometres. Planning extents exclude sea but can include reservoirs and inland water, and differ from physical land area.
